sources.quote: Input: $10.00 / 1M tokens Cached input: $2.50 / 1M tokens Output: $40.00 / 1M tokens
sources.supports: OpenAI's pricing page archived June 8, before the June 10 reduction, shows o3's old rates.

sources.quote: Jun 10 Released o3-pro, a version of the o3 reasoning model that uses more compute to answer hard problems with better reasoning and consistency. Prices for the o3 model have also been reduced for all API requests, including batch and flex processing.
sources.supports: OpenAI dates the o3 price reduction to June 10, 2025.
OpenAI's model documentation lists the official post-reduction o3 rates, including cached input at $0.50 per million tokens.
The Internet Archive CDX index records the June 8 pricing snapshot used to document rates before OpenAI's June 10 reduction.

notes: The cited models.dev entry already had OpenAI's post-reduction $2 input/$8 output prices; its June 17 change added the omitted $0.50 cached-input rate. OpenAI's changelog dates the base-price reduction to June 10, but the available primary sources do not state when the cached-input rate was introduced separately. The archived June 8 page was fetched successfully; subsequent Archive snapshot fetches failed, so the June 11/17 page contents could not be independently verified.
